description: Canonical machine-readable dispatch table for the ticket-auto router. Transcribed from skills/ticket-auto/SKILL.md's Dispatch Loop section. Two consumers read this file: the SKILL.md dispatch-table generator (skills/ticket-flow/gen-dispatch-table.py), which renders the markdown table between the GENERATED markers in SKILL.md, and fleetd's phase-dispatch module, which loads it as its phase-sequencing structure. Neither the markdown table nor the Python implementation is the source of truth — this file is.
source_of_truth_note: Entry order is significant: it is the render order of SKILL.md's table. Edit this file, then run the generator; never hand-edit the generated section.

step_variables.APPRAISE_FROM: Per-phase resume step for /ticket-appraise, emitted by detect-resume.sh.

cycle_counters.VERIFY_ATTEMPTS: Verify retry counter, derived by detect-resume.sh from VERIFY terminal lines.
cycle_counters.ITERATION: PR-review iteration counter, derived from PR-REVIEW terminal lines carrying a canonical VERDICT token.
cycle_counters.PR_FEEDBACK_CYCLE: PR comment reconciliation counter, derived from the cycle#N marker in the pr-reconcile terminal line.

spawn.description: Investigate the ticket and produce complexity score

pre_dispatch.description: Claim the ticket before the spawn so Linear reflects that work has started. Idempotent; complexity defaults to simple and is corrected in STEP_4.

spawn.description: Reproduce the bug and capture evidence

steps.description: Reproduce: confirm the bug manifests before any implementation work. Gate-stops with REPRO_NOT_CONFIRMED or REPRO_BLOCKED.

spawn.description: Create implementation artifacts (simple-fix.md or OpenSpec change)

steps.description: Exec: artifact creation. Gate-stops with EXEC_NO_ARTIFACT when no artifact is produced.

exit_codes.0: auto-approved — loop back to state detection
exit_codes.1: held — write META|gate-held|info|held, finalize with exit 0, stop
exit_codes.2: gate-stop — structural failure, finalize with exit 1

steps.description: Approval gate. Deterministic bash, no Claude agent involved.
Alias entry. detect-resume.sh can emit either STEP_2_5 or STEP_3 for the gate; both dispatch identically.

loop.description: Caps the hold -> re-approve -> re-hold cycle.

spawn.description: Reconcile comments after gate hold and re-approval
spawn.instructions: Follow the skill exactly. Load context from env.sh, pipeline log, and artifact files.

steps.description: Gate reconcile. Spawned only when a held ticket is re-approved.

steps.table_action: Spawn `ticket-implement` agent, run `return-completeness-check.sh` (openspec tickets only), then `outcome-label-check.sh`

spawn.description: Implement the changes described in the artifact
spawn.instructions: Use Serena for all code navigation. For openspec tickets: first read tasks.md in full, then proceed task by task. Pre-warm by reading all task descriptions before starting implementation.

post_dispatch.description: Openspec tickets only. Phase 1 logs META|gate-warn|info|RETURN_INCOMPLETE and never flips done to fail. Phase 2+ (enforce mode) MUST map a non-zero exit to spawn_agent_post RESULT=fail.
Always runs after implement. Writes META|outcome-label|info|<Smooth|Rough|Hard>, which the auto-merge check reads.

Ready → Review once implementation is committed and pushed. The router fires this one itself (SKILL.md:897-910); every other lifecycle trigger (human-approve, pr-review-pass-done/uat, uat-pass) is fired by the phase skill that earns it, so it travels with the phase and needs no owner in the dispatch layer.
Emits planner feedback for planned tickets; no-op for unplanned.

RLVR Phase 1 advisory inspection. Spawned only when assemble_inspector_context yields INSPECTOR_INSTRUCTIONS. Captured with ATTEMPT=inspector so it appends rather than overwriting the implement agent's own capture.

steps.description: Implement. The one phase that overrides the generic post-spawn ordering: the completeness gate must see the agent's return before the router commits the phase as done.

loop.body: verify -> (on FAIL) re-implement with --from-auto -> outcome-label-check -> verify
loop.description: Hard cap of 2 total attempts (1 initial + 1 retry), reduced from 3: verify agent instability means a third attempt rarely succeeds.

precondition.description: VERIFY_LAST=fail means the pipeline crashed after a terminal verify FAIL but before the re-implement step ran. Resuming straight into verify would re-run against the same unfixed code, so re-implement is dispatched first and verify follows. A code supervisor MUST evaluate this before the spawn — it is dispatch-relevant control flow that the step->action table alone does not express.

spawn.instructions: Follow the skill exactly. Use per-criterion checkpointing: after each criterion passes, write VERIFY|checkpoint|done|criterion-{N}-pass to LOG_FILE. If the agent crashes, resume from the last checkpoint — do not restart from criterion 1. PHASE_RESULT_ATTEMPT=$(({VERIFY_ATTEMPTS} + 1)) — emit this verbatim as the ATTEMPT field of your phase result block.

pre_dispatch.on_failure: log META|preflight|fail|VERIFY_PREFLIGHT_FAILED and proceed — the failure still counts as an attempt
pre_dispatch.description: Confirm Playwright and Linear MCP are reachable before spawning an agent that would inevitably fail without them.
Crash diagnostics path that survives agent crashes.

post_dispatch.description: Advisory, observe-only. Takes the LAST block in the capture file, which is this attempt's.
Runs before the retry/advance decision but does not affect it.

steps.description: Verify with router-managed retry. On PASS the pipeline advances to STEP_4_6.

loop.gate_stop_code_note: Named in fleetd-phase-supervisor task 4.6, having shipped unnamed. Every consumer of a gate-stop code (pipeline-postmortem.sh's exit-path and severity maps, pipeline-finalize.sh's outcome line) already has a default branch, so adding a name breaks none of them; leaving it unnamed made pipeline-finalize.sh record the literal outcome "stopped: gate-stop " for the pipeline's most-travelled loop — a run that stopped without recording why. Now documented alongside VERIFY_EXHAUSTED and PR_FEEDBACK_EXHAUSTED.
loop.body: pr-review -> (on WARN) gate-check.sh --mode reapprove -> pr-iterate -> implement -> outcome-label-check -> flow.sh implement-complete -> verify -> pr-review
loop.description: Router-managed pr-review -> pr-iterate -> re-implement -> verify -> pr-review cycle.

spawn.description: Review the PR for code quality and correctness
spawn.instructions: Follow the skill exactly. Return verdict: ✅ ✅, ⚠️, or ❌. PHASE_RESULT_ATTEMPT=$(({ITERATION} + 1)) — emit this verbatim as the ATTEMPT field of your phase result block.

verdict_routing.WARN: if ITERATION < 3, reapprove-gate then run the loop body; else gate-stop

sub_steps.instructions: Apply the requested changes from the PR review.

post_dispatch.description: Advisory inspection; does not affect the verdict routing.

conditions: AUTONOMY is auto or semi-auto (manual never merges)
the PR head is not INTEGRATION_BRANCH
post_dispatch.description: Runs after an OK verdict. The outcome is read from the META|outcome-label|info| line — the confirmed Linear label — never from the IMPLEMENT terminal line, which does not carry Smooth/Rough/Hard.

sequence.description: Process wiki errata and update documentation

steps.description: Documentation and wiki maintenance. Non-blocking: a failure warns and the pipeline continues.

loop.description: Caps repeated human review rounds. The terminal line MUST carry a cycle#N counter or the cap never advances past 0.

spawn.description: Reconcile PR comments from human reviewers
spawn.instructions: Check for new human comments on the open PR. Apply amend/push-back/clean logic.

steps.description: PR comment reconciliation for human reviewer feedback after the automated review passed.

retro_trigger_conditions: a META|gate-stop|fail| line fired during this run
the run lacks both a VERIFY|verify|done|PASS line and a PR-REVIEW|pr-review|done|OK line
a |fallback| event appears in the heartbeat log (also writes META|drift|warn|)
VERIFY_EXHAUSTED appears anywhere in the log (sub-shell visibility safety net)
a VERIFY|verify|fail| line appears (same sub-shell concern)

post_dispatch.description: Ordered after STEP_5 so the document agents still have worktree access for git diff/log.
Writes META|outcome. Called at every exit point, not only here; a tail-check idempotency guard prevents double-writing on crash-resume.

steps.description: Report: retro auto-trigger evaluation, worktree release, outcome write.
Default case for an unrecognised RESUME_STEP.
